context:
Goal: questions your rulings already answer stop reaching you.
Problem (rule): a general check would also stop a question asking you to change your shared-tool ruling itself, and only you can say whether that question may still reach you.
Based on (read): this is not a guard for one kind of question; PR #2929 adds one general check on every question a session sends you: when every option but one would bend a shared tool to fit one repo, your ruling already picks the remaining option, so the check refuses the question and the session takes that option itself.
Based on (read): in a question about changing the ruling itself, the option to change it bends the tool by definition, so the same check refuses it.
Based on (ruling): decision uniform-over-variants: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
Departs from: main lets every such question reach you — PR #2929 refuses the ones your ruling answers, and this item decides whether a question about changing the ruling is refused as well.
home: decision uniform-over-variants (a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo)

options.gain: One rule, no exception in the check.
options.how: The check refuses every such question; to revisit the ruling, you say so in chat or a session asks in a question with no widening option.
options.label: Refuse it; you raise a revisit (Recommended)
options.lose: A session cannot ask you to revisit the ruling in that form.

options.gain: A session can ask you to revisit the ruling.
options.how: A question marked as a revisit of uniform-over-variants passes the check. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Let a revisit question through
options.lose: A marker the check accepts, which a session could use to skip it.
